svg.desc: The parts of an AI teammate (package, identity, harness, discipline), each with its bill-of-materials line and the body its practice comes from.
svg.text: The bill of materials as a tree
role.mdwhat they are for, who answers for them
handover.mdwhat the next session gets: their own only
circle (private)whom they act toward alone; never published
MANIFEST.jsonevery file's hash, signed by the owner
the private key, in OS custody
a fingerprint of the public key
published, or answered by an endpoint
instruction file, read at startCLAUDE.md · AGENTS.md · GEMINI.md
hooks, sub-agents, built-in memoryadd-ons; they differ per harness
The discipline: applies to all of it
a check is trusted once seen to fail
the builder is not the verifier
The guards: what a failure leaves behind
state/lessons.mdwhat went wrong, the guard added, seen to fail
patterns.md, or the instruction filelessons that passed review; a human can veto
Numbers are the lines of the bill of materials (BOM.md); section names are the OATHS sections that specify each practice. Generated by tools/make-bom-tree.py.
